'''"The Battle of Naboo"''' was one of the songs played by a [[Unidentified young new recruit|young Jedi recruit]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] sometime after [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It featured in a songbook specifically created to remind [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] of his homeworld. It was a song about the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|forces]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].
